text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for service=text-gen (5m window). SLO burn=18%. PagerDuty page PD-2331 fired. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alert/2331

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page PD-2331 -> routed to oncall-sre (priority: P1). Please acknowledge.

raj: acked and taking it. :white_check_mark: Seeing initial spike — p99 ~3.2s in us-west-2.

emma: ack. I'm pulling traces and logs now.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up +2 nodes (us-west-2) 3m ago. No failed scale actions.

raj: looking at traces — tail is concentrated on worker-07. Lots of 502/504 from the sidecar to the model pod for a small subset of keys -> possible hotkey or KV cache thrash.

marco: can we temporarily route suspected hotkey traffic away from the general pool? suggestion: divert to pool-hotkeys for a few minutes.

emma: pulling metrics: grafana query shows a handful of keys responsible for ~40% of requests in the burst.

raj: going to enact short reroute and evict the KV prefix on worker-07. Will post commands.

marco: if reroute works, we can rollback and watch for recurrence.

emma: running commands now:

```
# temporary routing rule to divert hotkey traffic
redwoodctl route set --service text-gen --match 'client_key=hot-123' --backend pool-hotkeys --ttl 300

# evict local KV cache on the problematic node
redwoodctl cache evict --node worker-07 --prefix "kv_user_hot-123"
```

ops-bot: Command results: route rule applied (id=rr-998). Cache eviction job queued -> completed in 10s. Worker-07: KV entries removed=1248.

lisa: customer-impact note: CS reported elevated latency for Acme Corp (ticket #4512). They're seeing timeouts on batch embeddings during the spike. I've drafted a short customer message.

raj: after eviction + reroute, p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 850ms (5m window). Error rate for the model calls also returned to baseline.

pagerduty: PD-2331 acknowledged by raj at 1705004380.

emma: logs show sidecar retries decreased and CPU on worker-07 normalized. No OOMs. Will keep an eye on warmup behavior.

raj: leaving a short mitigation note and will hand off to next oncall in 30m. @sre-rotation can you pick up post-mortem items and follow-up metrics?

sre-rotation: I can take follow-ups. Please link any queries/runbooks.

raj: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/latency-hotkey. Action items: 1) add targeted cache warming for known hotkeys 2) consider per-key rate limit or dedicated pool 3) bake a metric for hotkey concentration.

lisa: I've shared the customer update draft with CS and tagged the account owner.

raj: marking page as resolved in PD after stabilization. Monitoring for 30m before full close. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

emma: p99 holding ~780-900ms for the last 10m. No further pages today unless recurrence.

sre-rotation: will run the follow-up checklist and schedule a short postmortem sync.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: alert PD-2331 closed (status: acknowledged -> resolved).
